hooks.name: register_configs
hooks.doc:
The config files native mods keep (NeoForge's `registerConfig`):
push yours, each of a kind, with the text written to `config/` when
the file is missing. Asked by the window when the game starts (its
`Client` and `Common` configs), by a dedicated server when it starts
(`Common` and `Server`) and by a server before each world it opens
(`Server`); a game reads only its own kinds, so push them all every
time. A file outside `config/`, or one already registered, is skipped.

hooks.name: config_loading
hooks.doc:
A registered config was read (`ModConfigEvent.Loading`): `config`
says whose, which file and its text, which the mod parses (TOML by
convention). Every mod hears every config, so check `mod_id`. Fired
where the config's kind loads (`native_register_configs`), a `Server`
one before `native_server_about_to_start`.

hooks.name: config_reloading
hooks.doc:
A loaded config's file changed on disk (`ModConfigEvent.Reloading`):
its new text. The game looks at the files' modification times once a
second, on the window and on the server's tick; a file saved with the
same text, removed or unreadable fires nothing and keeps its last
text.

hooks.name: config_unloading
hooks.doc:
A `Server` config is dropped as its server stops
(`ModConfigEvent.Unloading`), after `native_server_stopping`; the next
world reads it again. `Client` and `Common` configs stay until the
game quits.

rust_summary:
mod config files, loaded and reloaded (`native_register_configs`, `native_config_loading`,
`native_config_reloading`, `native_config_unloading`; `native_configs.rs`).
doc_summary: mod config files, loaded and reloaded (`ModConfigEvent`). `native_register_configs` lists a mod's configs: `NativeConfig::new(mod_id, kind, default)`, a file `config/<mod id>-<kind>.toml` (`.file(..)` names another of the mod's own files, as `Host::config_files` reads them: in `config/<mod id>/`, or `config/<mod id>.<ext>` or `config/<mod id>-<rest>`) written from `default` when missing. `Client` configs load on the window when the game starts, `Common` once per process (the window, or a dedicated server), `Server` on the server before `native_server_about_to_start` for each world, read from the world's `serverconfig/<file>` when there is one. `native_config_loading` hands over the file's text (`NativeConfigFile`: mod id, kind, file, text); the mod parses it, and checks `mod_id`, since every mod hears every config. A mod saves a config by writing it with `Host::config_files`; the game looks at the files' modification times once a second and fires `native_config_reloading` with changed text; the same text saved again fires nothing. `native_config_unloading` drops a server's configs when it stops. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mod_configs@.
